name: Kayla Marroquin
occupation: Albany County clerk of district court-elect taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results)
background: Kayla Marroquin is the Albany County clerk of district court-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Stacy Lam, who is serving through the current term. The Laramie Reporter reported that there was no incumbent on the 2026 ballot and that Marroquin, a Democrat, defeated Republican Dwain Streeter 6,479 votes (52%) to 6,003 (48%). No separate public-record account of her private occupation or education was confirmed in the official pages and other public records reviewed for this Profile.
